class1_acp.src: 225 CMR 14.08(4)(a)2 ($40 from CY2023, no CPI index); R2 §E1

class1_scope.rule: Class I RECs come from RPS Class I generation only; stand-alone storage earns none. GridSense models the Massachusetts market only (the $40 ACP also applies in CT and RI, not modelled)

clean_peak_seasons.hour_rule: hour-beginning: hour h counts when start_hour <= h < end_hour (17-21 = HB17-HB20 = clock 17:00-21:00), as rules/revenue.js applies it
clean_peak_seasons.rule: Seasonal Peak Periods on business days only; certificates = metered MWh in the window × seasonal multiplier (× 25 in the hour of actual monthly system peak)
clean_peak_seasons.note: DOER emergency amendments of 2026-05-28 not read (R2 open question R5).

clean_peak_scope.rule: Storage must pass the 225 CMR 21.05(1)(a)2 test (co-location with a Qualified RPS Resource of at least 75% of storage nameplate, contractual pairing, or charging in the renewable windows); the Near-term Resource Multiplier is not available at transmission interconnection
